judge.rationale: While the core validation and WeakMap caching logic in `registry.ts` works functionally, the candidate violates multiple strict lint and build gates specified in the acceptance criteria. First, five of the six unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` lack `[validated by: ...]` links in `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, which fails the `re-lint/require-spec-link` rule. Second, `registry.ts` uses default import `import Ajv from 'ajv'` (instead of `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`), adds multi-line JSDoc comments on `register` and `execute` despite the ticket explicitly requiring a one-line doc comment for `re-lint/max-comment-lines`, uses `(err as any)` casts in `registry.ts` and `any` in `registry.test.ts`, and modifies `docs/adding-a-tool.md` without updating the synced `example/weather-tool.ts` block. Finally, it misses the required test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, fails to test actual value redaction in `registry.test.ts` (asserting `'MY-SECRET-123'` is absent when `123` was passed), and leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree.
